name: Handling Your Finances
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor the Lord with their possessions and to manage their resources wisely, as seen in Proverbs 3:9 and Proverbs 21:20. The Proverbs emphasize diligence and thoughtful stewardship, encouraging labor and careful oversight rather than slothfulness or reckless spending (Proverbs 6:6; 13:11; 27:23). Additionally, the Bible warns of the dangers of debt, highlighting that borrowers become servants to lenders (Proverbs 22:7), underscoring the importance of financial responsibility within a Christ-centered life.
